channel.title: The Mother of a Hell-Spawn Goat Fetus
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "The Mother of a Hell-Spawn Goat Fetus" - A humanoid goat that, when killed, explodes a goat fetus that will wreak havoc until neutralized.

item.title: Mod Post - Open
item.content:encoded:
Hey Savanac -

An author getting the same feedback from two different people is often times a good thing! It means that the issue is deeper than a single reviewer's feedback, and it can be really helpful to hear that something isn't working for many people.

It's ok for two people to say the same thing, and they may even have unique ways of pointing out the same flaw that allow the author to glean more information and ideas!

item.title: Re: The Mother of a Hell-Spawn Goat Fetus
item.content:encoded:
It just feels like it's a random encounter that keeps respawning, with a link to an established Big Bad thrown in for good measure.

If the hunter has a name and background, a reason for going after the goat, and even acted like he knew about the baby goat you may have something. But there are just too many missing parts.

item.title: Re: The Mother of a Hell-Spawn Goat Fetus
item.content:encoded:
[+] Open
[-] Close

Here's some crit:

[REDACTED]

I suggest you read through this document on how to avoid the blackbox whenever practical. And there's a ton of Foundation Sites that your SCP can be at, here's a list of them, you can even make one up, anything to avoid the dreaded blackbox.

SCP-XXXX-1 has DNA which may relate to the Scarlet King.

How does this add anything to the story. Also, don't use "may" when giving your concept, does it or does it not?

explodes a goat fetus that will wreak havoc

Do you have anything to say that this isn't just "gore for the sake of gore"? To me it seems like this "exploding goat fetus" adds nothing to the story.

Central Narrative:

Speaking of the story, what exactly is it? The recovery by the MTF? The incident about the hunter getting into the site? These seem like B-Plots rather than some over-arching narrative that is generally required for successful articles.

I think my main issue with this is just that it seems a bit silly, a humanoid goat that explodes when killed and shoots out a flying fetus. Stranger things exist, but what is the reason that this one should?


JamaisJ, can you start refreshing the page in another tab or something before you post your crit? This is the second time you've posted crit minutes after me and reiterated the same points.

Riemann is right, the more crit and eyes on a post the better. I'm sorry for calling you out JamaisJ

item.title: The Mother of a Hell-Spawn Goat Fetus
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch

  • A talking goat, that when alive, will cause a humanoid resembling a hunter to appear nearby.
  • The hunter will get to the goat through any means necessary, minus violence, and will kill the goat.
  • When the goat is dead, it will explode and a flying goat fetus will emerge.

Central Narrative:
Reports of a man wearing a goat costume and walking around a forest are being made. The Foundation brushes it off until reports of a flying baby that is shooting are made.

The foundation sends a Mobile Task Force to retrieve and detain SCP-XXXX (the goat) and SCP-XXXX-1 (flying goat fetus).

SCP-XXXX cooperates with Foundation personnel whereas SCP-XXXX-1 does not cooperate. Foundation Personnel request to neutralize SCP-XXXX-1 and the request is approved.

A hunter appears outside of Site [REDACTED] and asks politely to enter. When personnel guarding Site [REDACTED] refuse to let the hunter in, it uses its supernatural abilities of politeness to force the personnel to let it in.

The hunter makes its way to SCP-XXXX and reaches into a black duffel bag it is holding. The hunter pulls out a Semi-Automatic Shotgun and shoots SCP-XXXX until SCP-XXXX is dead. The hunter then disappears.

A few minutes SCP-XXXX begins to boil and then explodes. Approximately 17 seconds after SCP-XXXX has exploded, SCP-XXXX-1 emerges.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: SCP-XXXX-1 has DNA which may relate to the Scarlet King.

Additional Notes

  • When it says [REDACTED] after site, that is supposed to be blacked out text, I just don't know how to do that.
  • This is my first time writing a proposal so any feedback on how to better word this or anything that should be added/removed would be greatly appreciated.
